summary: Local dashboard performance: scoped reads, request-owned streamed SSR batches, optional delivery and idle query activation.
noAssistantImpact: No assistant capability, tool, procedure, permission, entitlement, confirmation, schema or provider action changes. Assistant UI lifecycle pauses optional idle reads while hidden, keeps drafts mounted, prevents hidden auto-start and preserves pending-command finalization/durable run recovery. Existing fresh server checks, scope reset and command owners remain. Other changes are internal tracing/read scheduling/code delivery. No deployment. Dashboard shell now reads current plan features through one joined projection rather than the full plan catalogue; canonical feature resolution/fallback is preserved. Full billing/entitlement readers and command admission are unchanged. Server reads now stream within one render-owned batch; API authentication/scope, browser mutation/body transport, deadlines and full command authority remain. Default-off diagnostics follow JSONL/SSE body lifetime, preserving bytes, cancellation and refusals without retaining content. Nine presentation routes now return their existing loading owners while prefetch remains pending; session/role/permitted-Store/pharmacy admission remains before reads. Setup and clinical workspace-access dependency waits remain. Customer channels now isolates optional read status/retries; current workspace refusal still removes admitted content, manager sections mount only with canManage, and existing API/procedure/command/sheet/invalidation authority is unchanged. Notification observers now stop interval repetition after the same three rejected-read codes already clearing private payloads. Focus/reopen/manual refresh and successful cadence remain. Four hooks are separated from presentation; mount scope, zero freshness/retention, aborts, exact inputs and business/financial commands are unchanged. QA-derived session validation now reads the same current binding/status/expiry/domain facts in one joined statement; managed-domain admission, legacy/missing handling, invalid-session revocation and outer session/command authority remain. No session token, grant digest or cross-request cache is selected or added. Default-off fixed diagnostics split proof facts from managed-domain work. Better Auth1.6.23 now uses its supported experimental joined reads for existing Session/User/Account relations. Cookie cache remains disabled; SDK signature/expiry/refresh/revocation and creation privacy/legal hooks, API bearer fallback/QA proof/legal/Store and command authority remain. No custom auth parser or new public auth capability. Global sheet feature code now loads on canonical typed URL intent and remains mounted after activation within the same actor/Tenant/Store. Existing factory access/path conditions, child props/keys/callbacks, current read/command checks, assistant owned-Job exception and message offer remain. Scope/access changes still remove the subtree; no query lifetime change or new assistant capability/command. Six existing route sheet form/workspace bodies now load only inside the same open/current admission branches. SheetFrame, title/Store reads, child props/keys, body lifetime, dismissal/errors and all command/read authority remain. Job step parsing moved unchanged into existing pure utilities and retains its old export; handoff refusal/fresh scope/release/invalidation are unchanged. Shared loading output markup is unchanged.

docs.note: Tracing/read scheduling only; no schema or migration.
